results.title: AMD Unveils MI400 Accelerator With 4x Throughput
highlights: AMD unveiled its MI400 accelerator, claiming 4x the FP16 throughput of the previous generation.
Shipments are expected to begin in the first half of next year, with hyperscaler design wins already announced.
